sections.title: Results & Impact
sections.executive_summary: Done With It demonstrates cross-platform mobile development expertise with React Native and Expo. The single codebase approach reduced development time by 50% compared to native iOS/Android development while delivering offline-first architecture, real-time messaging, and push notifications.

sections.title: Mobile Success
highlights: Single codebase serving iOS and Android platforms
50% reduction in development time vs native development
Real-time messaging between buyers and sellers
Push notifications with Expo Server SDK integration

sections.title: Technical Excellence
sections.summary: Done With It showcases production-ready mobile patterns including image optimization with Sharp, location services, JWT authentication, and comprehensive form validation. The architecture enables rapid feature iteration while maintaining cross-platform consistency.

businessRequirements.businessContext: Build a cross-platform mobile marketplace application enabling users to buy and sell items locally with photo uploads, messaging, and location services
businessRequirements.problemStatement: Traditional mobile app development requires separate codebases for iOS and Android, leading to duplicated effort, higher costs, and slower time to market
businessValue: Single codebase for iOS and Android reduces development time by 50%
Lower maintenance costs with shared business logic
Offline support ensures app functionality without connectivity
acceptanceCriteria: ✓ Users can register and authenticate with JWT
✓ Photo uploads with image optimization and thumbnails
✓ Real-time messaging between buyers and sellers
✓ Form validation with clear error messages
